# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Style

Laravel MVC monolith with a service layer (`app/Services`), queued jobs on Redis/Horizon (`app/Jobs`, `config/horizon.php`), scheduled artisan commands (`routes/console.php`) and an Inertia + React admin UI (`resources/js/pages`) in the same codebase.

### Directory layout

```
ms-mni/
├── app/
│   ├── Console/Commands/      # mni:*, cnj:*, monitoramentos:*, exportacoes:*, media:*, app:* artisan commands
│   ├── Exceptions/            # MNIException (normalizes MNI messages), JsonException
│   ├── Helpers/functions.php  # global helpers (cleanNumeroProcesso, cleanCPF_CNPJ, ...) via composer "files"
│   ├── Http/
│   │   ├── Controllers/Api/   # REST API: ConsultarProcesso, Documento, DownloadProcesso, MonitoramentoProcesso, Tribunal
│   │   ├── Controllers/       # Inertia web: Auth, Dashboard, ApiToken, Monitoramento, Processo, Tribunal
│   │   ├── Middleware/        # ValidateApiToken, InjectCredenciaisPjePadrao, HandleInertiaRequests, AuthorizePulse, ...
│   │   ├── Requests/          # FormRequests (Api/ monitoramento + exportação; web ApiToken, Tribunal)
│   │   └── Resources/         # MonitoramentoResource, MonitoramentoExecucaoResource, ComunicacaoPJe resource
│   ├── Jobs/                  # 10 queued jobs (MNI download/consulta, exportação, monitoramento, webhooks)
│   ├── Models/                # Eloquent: Processo*, Tribunal, ApiToken, CredencialPje, TipoDocumento, CNJ tables, User
│   ├── Providers/             # AppServiceProvider, HorizonServiceProvider (viewHorizon gate)
│   ├── Rules/CallbackUrl.php  # validation rule wrapping CallbackUrlValidator
│   └── Services/
│       ├── IntegracaoBase.php, SoapClientMNI.php   # SoapClient wrapper + MTOM/XOP parsing
│       ├── MNI/Intercomunicacao/  # SOAP ops: ConsultarProcesso, ConsultarDocumento, ConsultarExpediente, ...
│       ├── MNI/Complementar/      # reference-data SOAP ops: assuntos, classes, competências, jurisdições, ...
│       ├── MNI/PadronizarMensagemMniService.php
│       ├── Processo/              # ProcessoService orchestration, Salvar* persistence, DetectarAlteracoes
│       ├── Monitoramento/         # CredencialPjeService
│       ├── Exportacao/            # ExportacaoProcessoService (DomPDF + FPDI + gs)
│       ├── Callback/              # CallbackNotifier, CallbackUrlValidator, exceptions
│       ├── ComunicacaoPJe/        # REST client for comunicaapi.pje.jus.br
│       └── Dashboard/             # DashboardMetricasService
├── bootstrap/app.php          # routing (web, api, console, health /up), trustProxies('*'), middleware aliases
├── config/                    # Laravel config + pje.php, horizon.php, pulse.php, octane.php, snappy.php, sentry.php, ...
├── database/
│   ├── migrations/            # 51 migrations
│   ├── schema/pgsql-schema.sql  # PostgreSQL dump: schemas public, cnj, pulse
│   ├── factories/, seeders/
├── docker/                    # dev Dockerfile, Dockerfile.aws.prod, prod/8.4/ (Octane+FrankenPHP), supervisord/, nginx/, php/, postgres/
├── docs/api/openapi.yaml      # OpenAPI 3.1 of the external API, served at /docs/api
├── resources/js/              # React + TS: pages/, components/ (shadcn ui/), layouts/, hooks/, lib/
├── resources/views/           # blade: app shell, docs/api (Redoc), processo/download (export cover), layouts/relatorio, vendor overrides
├── routes/                    # api.php, web.php, console.php (scheduler)
├── tests/                     # Pest: Feature/{Api,Auth,Console,Jobs,Migrations}, Unit/{Models,Services,Exceptions}
├── traefik/                   # local reverse-proxy TLS config
└── docker-compose.yml         # php (FrankenPHP), redis 7.4.0, postgres pgvector/pgvector:pg18
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer | Owns | Does NOT own |
|---|---|---|
| Routes (`routes/api.php`, `web.php`, `console.php`) | URL → controller, middleware groups, scheduler entries | Validation, business rules |
| Middleware (`app/Http/Middleware`) | `X-API-Token` auth + usage stamp, default PJe credential injection (consulta group only), Inertia shared props, Pulse access | Persistence, domain decisions |
| FormRequests (`app/Http/Requests`) | Input rules, `numero_processo` normalization in `prepareForValidation` | Authorization (`authorize()` returns `true`; auth = middleware) |
| API controllers (`Controllers/Api`) | Orchestration, DB lookups, HTTP status codes, job dispatch | SOAP calls, PDF generation, webhook delivery |
| Web controllers (`Controllers/*`) | Inertia pages, admin CRUD for tribunais and tokens | External API auth |
| Resources (`app/Http/Resources`) | JSON shape of monitoramento + execução | Other endpoints (they return Eloquent models via `response()->json()`) |
| `Services/MNI` + `IntegracaoBase` | One class per SOAP operation; recibo error → exception → `MNIException` | Persistence |
| `Services/Processo` | Persist MNI payload (`updateOrCreate`), queue binary downloads, change snapshot/delta | HTTP concerns |
| `Services/Monitoramento`, `Exportacao`, `Callback`, `Dashboard` | Credential resolution, PDF pipeline steps, outbound webhook POST + URL safety, dashboard metrics | Queue retry policy |
| Jobs (`app/Jobs`) | Async units: queue name, `$tries`, `$timeout`, `backoff()`, failure marking | Scheduling (dispatcher command owns monitoramento reschedule) |
| Console commands | Scheduled dispatch/cleanup, ops re-send/re-download tools | Request handling |
| Models (`app/Models`) | Table mapping, `STATUS_*` constants, casts (`encrypted`, `array`), `$hidden`, uuid generation, scopes (`vencidos`, `doToken`, `valido`) | Workflow orchestration |

### External integration points

| System | Client/config | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Tribunal MNI SOAP | `App\Services\IntegracaoBase` → `SoapClientMNI` (`cache_wsdl` `WSDL_CACHE_NONE`, http timeout 1800 s, gzip/deflate) | URL per tribunal: `url_webservice_mni`, `url_webservice_mni_consultar_processo`, `url_webservice_mni_complementar` |
| Comunica PJe REST | `App\Services\ComunicacaoPJe\ConsultarProcessoService` (`Http::withoutVerifying()->get`) | No call site of `execute()` found under `app/` |
| AWS S3 | `config/filesystems.php` disk `s3` (`AWS_*`), `league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3` | `temporaryUrl(..., now()->addMinutes(60))` for links |
| Client webhooks | `App\Services\Callback\CallbackNotifier` (`Http::withHeaders(...)->timeout(10)->post`) | `X-API-Token` = client `callback_token` |
| Redis | `config/database.php` redis client `phpredis`; `config/horizon.php` | Queue backend for all supervisors |
| Ghostscript | `exec('gs -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -dCompatibilityLevel=1.4 ...')` in `ExportacaoProcessoService` | Falls back to original PDF on non-zero exit |
| Sentry / Discord | `config/sentry.php`, `config/logging.php` channels `sentry`, `discord` | Log channels |

### Runtime processes

| Env | Source | Programs |
|---|---|---|
| Dev | `docker/supervisord/supervisord.conf` | `frankenphp php-server --listen :80 --root /var/www/app/public`, `schedule:work`, `horizon`, `pulse:check` |
| Prod (Coolify) | `docker/prod/8.4/supervisord-coolify.conf` | `artisan octane:start --server=frankenphp --port=80 --admin-port=2019`, `schedule:work`, `horizon`, `pulse:check` |
| PM2 alt | `queue-work.yaml`, `schedule-run.yaml` | `queue:work --timeout=1000`, `schedule:run` |

### Queue topology

| Queue | Horizon supervisor | Jobs | tries / timeout | maxProcesses prod / local |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alta`, `default` | `supervisor-default` | `Consultar{DadosBasicos,Movimentos,Documentos}ProcessoMNIJob`, `BaixarProcessoMNIJob` (no queue set → `default`) | 3 / 600 | 8 / 2 |
| `mni-download` | `supervisor-mni-download` (balance auto) | `BaixarDocumentoMNIJob` | 3 / 300 | 8 / 4 |
| `exportar-processo` | `supervisor-exportar` (memory 1024) | `GerarPdfExportacaoJob`, `EnviarParaS3ExportacaoJob`, `EnviarWebhookDownloadJob` | 3 / 600 | 1 / 2 |
| `monitoramento` | `supervisor-monitoramento` (balance off) | `ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob` | 1 / 660 | 1 / 1 (serial in all envs) |
| `monitoramento-webhook` | `supervisor-monitoramento-webhook` | `EnviarWebhookMonitoramentoJob` | 3 / 60 (job sets `$tries = 5`) | 2 / 1 |

### Macro flow: Monitoramento periódico

```
scheduler (routes/console.php: everyThirtyMinutes()->withoutOverlapping())
        |
        v
+----------------------------------------------+
| monitoramentos:despachar                     |
|  DB::transaction                             |
|   ProcessoMonitoramento::vencidos()          |
|   ->lock('for update skip locked') chunk 200 |
|   set bloqueado_ate = now + 120 min          |
|   set proxima_execucao_em = now + intervalo  |
+----------------------+-----------------------+
                       | dispatch(id) -> queue "monitoramento" (1 worker)
                       v
+----------------------------------------------+
| ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob (tries 1)   |
|  snapshot(movimentos, documentos)            |
|  ProcessoService::consultarNumero(.., false) |
|  delta -> ProcessoMonitoramentoExecucao      |
|     sucesso: falhas=0, data_referencia=today |
|     falha:   falhas+1, >=5 -> suspenso       |
+----------------------+-----------------------+
                       | always dispatch(execucao_id) -> "monitoramento-webhook"
                       v
+----------------------------------------------+
| EnviarWebhookMonitoramentoJob (tries 5)      |
|  lockForUpdate, skip if webhook_enviado_em   |
|  CallbackNotifier POST callback_url          |
|  2xx ok | 4xx permanent fail | 5xx retry     |
|  backoff 10s, 60s, 300s, 900s, 3600s         |
+----------------------------------------------+
```

### Macro flow: Exportação de processo (PDF)

```
POST /api/processo/download
        |
        v
ExportacaoProcessoService::criar  (status enfileirado)  --none matching--> 404
        |
        v  queue "exportar-processo"
+----------------------------------------------+
| GerarPdfExportacaoJob (tries 3, timeout 600) |
|  status processando                          |
|  best-effort ProcessoService::consultarNumero|
|  DomPDF capa (view processo.download)        |
|  + FPDI merge of S3 docs (gs -> PDF 1.4)     |
|  -> storage/app/private/exportacoes/{uuid}.pdf
+----------------------+-----------------------+
                       v
+----------------------------------------------+
| EnviarParaS3ExportacaoJob (tries 3)          |
|  backoff 10s, 30s, 60s                       |
|  s3 downloads/{user_id}/{uuid}.pdf           |
|  status concluido                            |
+----------------------+-----------------------+
                       v
+----------------------------------------------+
| EnviarWebhookDownloadJob (tries 5)           |
|  POST callback_url {download_url 60 min}     |
+----------------------------------------------+

any failure -> marcarComoFalhou (status falhou, erro_resumo) -> EnviarWebhookDownloadJob
```

### Macro flow: Consulta assíncrona e download de binários

```
GET /api/processo/consultar/{dados-basicos|movimentos|documentos}/async
        |  queue "alta"
        v
Consultar*ProcessoMNIJob -> ProcessoService::consultar* -> CallbackNotifier
        POST callback_url {numero_processo, tipo, status: "concluido"}

SalvarDocumentoProcessoService::salvarDocumento (status != baixado, baixar_binarios=true)
        |  queue "mni-download"
        v
BaixarDocumentoMNIJob (ShouldBeUnique by documento id, uniqueFor 1800)
        -> SOAP document fetch by mimetype -> S3 documentos-processos/{numero}/{id}.{ext}
        -> status baixado | erro (re-queued by mni:baixar-documento-pendente)
```
